label: Research
description: An agent researches a question on a schedule and keeps a feed of findings.

routines.name: Research
routines.does: Looks into the question and adds new findings to the feed.
routines.prompt: Read question.json in this folder: it holds the question to research. Search the web for what is new or still unanswered. Read feed.json (a JSON list) so you do not repeat a finding. Append 1 to 3 NEW findings as objects {"title": "short headline", "finding": "two plain sentences", "sources": ["https://..."], "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"} and write the file back as valid JSON. If question.json has no question, do not invent one: report that it is empty. If there is nothing new, add nothing.
